title: A build whose create-door claim never reached a site or a job is lost after ten minutes
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm the test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A requesting build idle 11 minutes with a claiming claim that has no site and no job reads failed REQUEST_LOST.
The same with a refused claim reads failed REQUEST_LOST.
A claim that names a host job keeps the build requesting.

tests: build: a dead create-door claim (no site, no job, idle or refused) does not keep a request alive; one with a job does
